passages.text: Overview Company Overview At Kenvue, our purpose is to realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. As a global leader at the intersection of healthcare and consumer goods, we are the world’s largest pure-play consumer health company by revenue with $15.1 billion in Net sales in the fiscal year 2025. By combining the power of science with meaningful consumer insights and our digital strategy, we empower consumers to live healthier lives every day. Built on more than a century of heritage and trusted by generations, our differentiated portfolio of iconic brands—including Aveeno ® , BAND-AID ® Brand, Johnson’s ® , Listerine ® , Neutrogena ® , Nicorette ® , Tylenol ® , and Zyrtec ® —is backed by science and recommended by healthcare professionals, which further reinforces our consumers’ connections to our brands. Our portfolio includes Self Care, Skin Health and Beauty, and Essential Health products, allowing us to connect with consumers globally in their daily rituals and the moments that matter most. Our global scale and the breadth of our brand portfolio are complemented by our well-developed capabilities and accelerated through our digital strategy, allowing us to dynamically capitalize on and respond to current trends impacting our categories and geographic markets. With a sole focus on consumer health, our marketing organization operates efficiently by leveraging our precision marketing, e-commerce, and broader digital capabilities to develop unique consumer insights and further enhance the relevance of our brands. Similarly, our research and development organization combines these consumer insights with deep, multi-disciplinary scientific expertise, and active engagement with healthcare professionals, to drive innovative new products, solutions, and experiences centered around consumer health. Our Business Segments We operate our business through the following three reportable business segments: • Self Care. Our Self Care product categories include: Cough, Cold, and Allergy; Pain Care; and Other Self Care (Digestive Health, Smoking Cessation, Eye Care, and Other). Major brands in the segment include Benadryl ® , Calpol ® , Motrin ® , Nicorette ® , Rhinocort ® , Tylenol ® , Zarbee’s ® , and Zyrtec ® . • Skin Health and Beauty. Our Skin Health and Beauty product categories include: Face and Body Care; and Hair, Sun, and Other. Major brands in the segment include Aveeno ® , Dr.Ci:Labo ® , Le Petit Marseillais ® , Lubriderm ® , Neutrogena ® , OGX ® , and Rogaine ® . • Essential Health. Our Essential Health product categories include: Oral Care; Baby Care; and Other Essential Health (Women’s Health, Wound Care, and Other). Major brands in the segment include BAND-AID ® Brand, Carefree ® , Desitin ® , Johnson’s ® , Listerine ® , o.b. ® tampons, and Stayfree ® . For additional information about our three reportable business segments, see Note 18 , “Segments of Business and Geographic Areas , ” to the Consolidated Financial Statements included herein . passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Summary of Risk Factors The following is a summary of the principal factors that make an investment in Kenvue speculative or risky: Risks Related to the Proposed Transaction with K-C • If the Proposed Transaction is consummated, the combined company may not perform as expected and may fail to realize the projected benefits and cost savings of the Proposed Transaction, which could adversely affect the value of K-C common stock, which our current shareholders will own following the completion of the Proposed Transaction. • Failure to consummate, or a delay in the consummation of, the Proposed Transaction. • Uncertainties associated with the Proposed Transaction may cause a loss of management and other key employees. • Our shareholders will have a significantly reduced ownership and voting interest in the combined company. • Litigation against us or K-C, or the members of our or K-C’s board of directors. • The Merger Agreement restricts our ability to pursue alternatives to the Proposed Transaction. • Regulatory approvals may delay the Proposed Transaction or may diminish its benefits. • The number of shares of K-C common stock issuable in the First Merger in respect of one share of our common stock is fixed and will not be adjusted. Because the market price of K-C common stock may fluctuate, our shareholders cannot be sure of the market value of the stock consideration they will receive in exchange for their shares. • If the Proposed Transaction fails to qualify as a “reorganization” within the meaning of Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “Code”), our shareholders may pay additional U.S. federal income taxes. • Uncertainties associated with the Proposed Transaction may disrupt our business. • The Proposed Transaction’s consummation is expected to trigger change-in-control or other provisions. • Failure to integrate our and K-C’s businesses and operations successfully in the expected time frame. • The Merger Agreement restricts certain business activities prior to the effective time of the Proposed Transaction. • We have incurred, and will continue to incur, significant costs in connection with the Proposed Transaction. • The Proposed Transaction may result in a loss of customers, distributors, service providers, suppliers, vendors, joint venture participants, and other business counterparties and may result in the termination of existing contracts. credit_strengths.text: Operating margin expanded sharply year over year and now sits above the sector median, reflecting a leaner cost base across the Self Care, Skin Health and Essential Health brand portfolio. This pricing and mix recovery supports internal cash generation and cushions the fixed cost of servicing the debt stack.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure plus dividends, and free cash flow alone covers the dividend, so the ordinary distribution is funded from internally generated cash rather than borrowings. This is the core support for the credit profile.

key_risks.text: The proposed transaction with K-C dominates the risk factor summary: failure to consummate or delay, fixed exchange ratio exposing shareholders to K-C price moves, change-in-control triggers, integration risk and significant transaction costs. These are event risks that could reprice the capital structure independent of operating performance.

Free cash flow falls short of total shareholder distributions once buybacks are added to the dividend, so the excess is funded from balance sheet capacity rather than cash generation. Distributions therefore absorb essentially all discretionary cash flow and limit deleveraging headroom.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage improved year over year and remains comfortably above unity, with operating income covering gross interest several times. Coverage nonetheless trails the sector median, so debt service is adequate but less cushioned than consumer staples peers carrying similar leverage.

Gross leverage declined year over year and net leverage sits below the next risk-band boundary, leaving modest headroom before a downgrade trigger. Leverage is nonetheless above the sector median on both gross and net bases, so the balance sheet is slightly more encumbered than peers.

overall_credit_view.text: The maturity ladder is long-dated, with the bulk of borrowings due after year five and only a modest slice falling in the next twelve months, so refinancing risk is limited and near-term liquidity needs are small relative to cash and annual cash flow.

We view the indicative financial risk profile as significant, driven by the cash-flow tier rather than leverage. The credit is investment-grade in character on coverage and maturity profile, but the pending transaction and full distribution payout keep the outlook event-driven rather than stable.

credit_strengths.text: 營業利潤率按年大幅擴張，現已高於行業中位數，反映 Self Care、Skin Health 及 Essential Health 品牌組合的成本基礎更為精簡。此定價與產品組合的復甦支撐內部現金生成，並緩衝償付債務結構的固定成本。
營運現金流覆蓋資本開支加股息，而自由現金流本身已覆蓋股息，故普通分派由內部產生現金而非借款撥付。此為信用狀況的核心支撐。

key_risks.text: 與 K-C 的擬議交易主導風險因素摘要：未能完成或延遲、固定換股比率令股東承受 K-C 股價波動、控制權變更觸發條款、整合風險及重大交易成本。此等為事件風險，可獨立於經營表現而重新定價資本結構。
一旦將回購加至股息，自由現金流不足以覆蓋股東總分派，故超額部分由資產負債表能力而非現金生成撥付。分派因此吸納幾乎所有可支配現金流，並限制去槓桿空間。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率按年改善，並仍穩健高於一倍，營業利潤覆蓋總利息數倍。然而覆蓋率仍落後於行業中位數，故償債能力充足，但緩衝較承擔相近槓桿的消費必需品同業為少。
總槓桿按年下降，淨槓桿處於下一風險區間邊界之下，在降級觸發前留有溫和空間。然而總槓桿及淨槓桿均高於行業中位數，故資產負債表較同業略為沉重。

overall_credit_view.text: 到期結構屬長年期，大部分借款於五年後到期，僅少量於未來十二個月內到期，故再融資風險有限，短期流動性需求相對現金及年度現金流為小。
我們視指示性財務風險狀況為顯著，由現金流層級而非槓桿所驅動。就覆蓋率及到期結構而言，該信用具投資級特徵，但待決交易及全額分派派付令展望由事件驅動而非穩定。
